cli.result:
The verifier passes. The cube is seated in the tray slot.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Distance from slot centre | 0.14 mm (tolerance 3 mm) |
| Speed | 0 mm/s |
| Held by gripper | no |

**What I did:** opened the gripper, descended top-down onto the cube on the bed, grasped it, lifted, carried it over the slot, rolled the wrist to bring the cube's yaw from about -49° to under 1° so it would fit the 22 mm pocket, lowered it to just above the funnel, and released. It slid in and settled at the pocket centre.

**One thing to flag:** on release, the arm's joints jumped by up to 10° and every joint reported a load spike. The open fingers likely contacted the tray or funnel wall at that height. The cube was unaffected, but on real hardware I would release a few millimetres higher or open the gripper less than fully. I stopped as instructed and left the arm where it is, so it has not been returned to home.
